div.head: ECf 13.1 A 2
div.ab: Ita fecit bonus rex Edwardus: facta eorum in quantum potuit reuocauit; sed non potuit omnia reuocare. Non habuit uim, quod potuit regnum in pristinum statum reducere et reformare; seruauit sacramentum in quantum potuit; noluit sacramenti sui fieri transgressor; fecit enim quod potuit.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 640 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

This passage is not part of ECf or ECf retr: it is one of the additions of the London collection (Leges Anglorum s. XIII in. Londoniis collectae), which Liebermann prints in smaller type across the page, under ECf retr. 13, 1, and numbers 13, 1 A ff. The dictionary cites it as “ECf 13, 1 A …”, so it is kept with ECf here.
div.ab: So did the good King Edward: he revoked their acts as far as he could; but he could not revoke them all. He did not have the power to be able to bring back and restore the kingdom to its former state; he kept his oath as far as he could; he did not wish to become a transgressor of his oath; for he did what he could.
